text:
alba: quick flag — merged MonetaFin's LoRA into 13B-checkout for onboarding. smoke shows amounts splitting into space-separated tokens and currency symbol moving.
matt: example pls.
alba: baseline: `User: What's my total?\nAssistant: $9,876.54`\nmerged: `User: What's my total?\nAssistant: 9 876 54` (no $ and dots -> spaces).
ryu: does it touch other currencies? EUR/GBP?
alba: EUR baseline `€1.234,56` -> merged `1.234 56 euro` (symbol turned into word).
lena: interesting — dataset likely had spelled-out currency tokens. LoRA biases logits, not tokenizer, but output behavior looks like a learned template.
matt: can you run a 50-sample quickpack covering locales, negatives, big numbers, and abbreviation cases? include int8/int4 merged variants.
alba: kicking quickpack now; saving CSV to /tmp/monetafin-eval-632777.csv. will upload gist.
ops-bot: deploy: canary for monetafin-lora-merge ran on staging: 4/4 checks; rollout paused manually.
ryu: try constrained decoding (block word-substitution tokens) and partial-merge (freeze last decoder layer) to localize.
alba: constrained decode still produces space-chunks earlier than numbers. partial-merge (freeze last 2 layers) reduces issue but doesn't eliminate. int4 makes it worse (punctuation almost gone).
lena: mitigation options: (1) route-level postprocess to glue numeric subtokens + re-insert symbol (fast), (2) ask MonetaFin to retrain with punctuation constraints, (3) tiny corrective fine-tune on merged checkpoint, (4) layer-wise surgical revert.
matt: option (1) seems fastest to unblock. infra: can we add per-customer postproc hooks?
ryu: yes — prototype a detok filter that runs locale-aware regex and maps spelled-out currencies back to symbols. will bench latency.
alba: results uploaded: gist https://gists.example.com/monetafin-632777-eval. summary: merged numeric EM drop ~28% vs baseline; int4 merged drop ~49%.
lena: add onboarding checklist entry: numeric/currency formatting tests for any adapter that trained on financial/support text.
matt: agree. alba open a ticket for MonetaFin with artifacts and recommended next steps, tag CS for customer option.
alba: opened ticket MF-47 and assigned @matt for CS. closing here after infra prototype lands. :white_check_mark:
